description: Every Semiosis contract on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) with its role and explorer link, and the outside contracts it uses: among them Semiosis’s Pons launch curve (outside, key ponsCurve), the `to` of a trade routed to Pons, which is Pons’s own contract and not verified on the explorer. Check a transaction’s `to` against this list before signing it.
